en.title: [Notice] 2026 Course Registration Precautions (Prerequisite/Follow-up Course Flowchart)
summary: Starting from 2026 course registration, a prerequisite/follow-up course flow will apply to [Smart Design courses] and [Programming courses]
[Smart Design courses] apply starting from the 2025 admission cohort (25학번)
[Programming courses] apply starting from the 2026 admission cohort (26학번)
Applicable students who wish to take these courses must take them in the order specified in the attached flowchart
See the attached image (course flowchart) for detailed order
en.easyExplanation: Starting in 2026, Smart Design courses and Programming courses will have a required order (prerequisite/follow-up) for enrollment. This applies to the 2025 cohort (25학번) for Smart Design and the 2026 cohort (26학번) for Programming, so eligible students must take these courses in the order shown in the notice.
en.target: Students affected by the new course flow: 2025 cohort (25학번) students for [Smart Design courses] and 2026 cohort (26학번) students for [Programming courses] who wish to take the relevant courses

originalContent:
2026학년도 수강신청부터
[스마트디자인 수업], [프로그래밍 수업] 의 선,후수 수강흐름도를 아래와 같이 안내합니다.
[스마트디자인 수업]은 25학번부터
[프로그래밍 수업]은 26학번부터 적용되므로, 해당되는 학생들이 아래 과목 수강을 원할 경우
반드시 아래의 순서대로 과목 수강하시기 바랍니다.
